title: Pam A NDE 934
content:
After falling down, I entered into another universe, I’d rather say into space, in a strong light. I felt wonderfully well, I was no more hungry and I didn’t suffer any more. It seemed to me that I was able to understand everything and to give, finally, a sense to my life. I was aware of being dead and earth seemed so far away. I had no more any link with earth, I knew flying. I met other beings, who, as me, had no body anymore. But anyway, I could enter them and then know what they felt and who they were, even if I didn’t know them. Then I met Christ himself. I recognized him straightaway. I understood he wanted me to go back to earth but I didn’t want to do so. But he told me it was not the time for me and that we’ll see each other again pretty soon. I’m very attached to my family but at this moment this had absolutely no importance at all. I had no opportunity at all to make contact with earth or people living on earth. And I was not anymore interested in doing so. I had been attracted back to earth and when I woke up, I was very angry against my family who helped me to breath again.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Met Christ himself and recognized him straightaway.
arrival.other_being_detail: Met other beings who had no body anymore; could 'enter them' and know what they felt and who they were.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as 'another universe' / 'space' in a strong light; Earth seemed far away.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: No tunnel or OBE described; entered 'another universe/space' with strong light; encountered other bodiless beings; met Christ; was told to return; felt attracted back to Earth; anger on waking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate entry into unearthly space/light without described OBE/tunnel; encounters occurred before return instruction.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported being able to 'enter' other bodiless beings and directly know what they felt and who they were.
